notes: January 2025 – 8 October 2026. One row per Republic, RQII and region, each month and each year (month = All).

Real, from the MFS accident-call (CRM) export: calls, serious emergencies, affected customers, first-contact resolution, CRM SLA, open, closed and reopened issues, and calls (i_) and repeat calls (r_) by issue type.
Synthetic: call-center offered, answered, answered within 20 seconds, wait, queue length, and consumption anomalies (an_no, an_low, an_spike). Anomalies run to August 2026.
service_level = calls answered within 20 seconds / calls answered. fcr = fcr_n / fcr_d. queue is the average callers waiting in staffed hours.
crm_sla_1, crm_sla_2, crm_sla_4 and crm_sla_24 are closed calls finished within 1, 2, 4 or 24 hours / closed calls with times. The page defaults to 1 hour.
top_issues is the five issue types with the most calls, excluding Other. repeated_issues is the five with the most repeat calls. Shares use the same denominators as the page.
BRQİİ and BRQSD are combined as BRQİİ / BRQSD.
